result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops the zip or `git-history.zip`. The `reports` module compiles. I did not run any tests or try a renamed config.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the zip-building block near the end of the data export. Instead of five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` names, it now builds each name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same method that names the loose text files. It reads each file back under that name and keeps the order main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

With the default config the entries are the same as before. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written again, provided a `git-history.txt` exists.

The landscape analyzer (`LandscapeAnalyzer.java`, lines 280–284) still hard-codes the same five file names. I left it alone because it wasn't part of the task. It will miss a renamed aspect's file list.
